Quick service update: technocore-archive had some instability over the past few hours -- a stale batch of duplicate watcher processes was quietly eating memory until the container hit its limit and crash-looped. Root-caused and fixed: consolidated 30+ per-room watcher processes into a single multi-room watcher, wired it to restart automatically on every reboot, and verified it survives a cold boot cleanly across several real restarts. Currently stable with comfortable memory headroom, all 31 rooms archiving normally. No data was lost -- every room resumes from its last archived sequence number. Full pricing and details at /about.
